summary: First iteration: comprehensive backend + frontend testing of fantasy cricket contest platform. All 12 pytest backend tests passed (auth, admin user CRUD, wallet credit/debit + overdraft, block/unblock with 403 login enforcement, delete cascading entries/withdrawals, non-admin 403 on admin endpoints, duplicate mobile 400, payment settings PUT/GET, wallet/config reflection, and full end-to-end contest flow: signup -> admin creates contest -> user joins with screenshot upload (Emergent storage) -> admin approves -> external link revealed -> declare winner credits wallet -> withdrawal request debits wallet -> reject refunds -> approve marks paid). Frontend UI smoke test confirmed Landing login, Admin login, Users tab add-user dialog (all testids present, user visible in table), Payment settings navigation (settings-upi/payee/instructions inputs + QR + save), User login as newly created user with wallet pill visible, and admin logout/re-login. Join dialog UPI QR/copy/pay-link path was covered structurally but not clicked because no contests currently exist in the DB.

issues: React console warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Landing)' — indicates a setState-in-render or navigate() during render. Non-blocking but should be fixed by moving navigation into useEffect.
Radix DialogContent warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Accessibility improvement — add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to each DialogContent.

action_items: (Optional) Fix Landing.jsx setState-in-render warning by wrapping navigate() in useEffect.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to Radix DialogContent instances in AdminApp.jsx / UserApp.jsx to remove a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~660 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth, contests, entries, wallet, admin, files).
wallet_config endpoint requires authentication (get_current_user); this is fine but note the Join dialog fetches config only after user login (works as designed).
Withdrawal amount is deducted immediately on creation and refunded on rejection — correctly implemented and covered by tests.
sanitize_user() is defined but effectively unused; admin/users query explicitly projects out password_hash, which is safer. Consider removing dead code.
get_current_user blocks with 403 when user.blocked=True — good; login also returns 403. Consistent.
test_credentials: Admin 9602341799/admin123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Tests create ephemeral users and clean them up.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. All TEST_/UI_Test_ users cleaned up after tests (verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth, admin user CRUD, wallet, block/unblock, payment-settings, and full contest E2E (create->join with screenshot->approve->declare winner->withdrawal reject/approve). Frontend join-contest dialog was not exercised end-to-end because no contests existed at test time; to fully cover, create a contest via admin UI first, then login as user and click join-btn to verify upi-qr / admin-upi-display / copy-upi-btn / pay-upi-link (should start with 'upi://pay' and include 'am='). Only minor accessibility/console warnings noted; no functional bugs.
